identity: Writer and politician · People's Republic of China · 1904–2005
title: Ba Jin's birth chart
metaDescription: Ba Jin's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 2.5° Sagittarius. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: The chart's headline is a opposition: Venus and Neptune within 0.2°, taste wired to imagination. An opposition is the tradition’s tug of war. Both ends are real, and the work is holding them at once rather than picking a winner.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun sits at 2.5° Sagittarius — the first decan, 0°–10°, which the tradition sub-rules by Jupiter. Degrees matter more than the sign label here: two people born a fortnight apart share Sagittarius and share almost nothing else about where the Sun actually stood.

blocks.title: Closer to the ground
blocks.text: The personal planets sit Mercury at 16.2° Sagittarius, Venus at 7.9° Capricorn, Mars at 2.9° Libra. Mercury in a fire sign reads as a mind that decides at speaking speed; Venus in a earth sign reads as taste for the substantial and the lasting; Mars in a air sign reads as drive that argues its way forward.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Jupiter and Pluto hold the closest angle here — a sextile, 0.1° wide. Sextiles are read as standing invitations — productive exactly as often as they are accepted. Behind it, Venus opposition Neptune at 0.2°, and the Sun sextile Mars at 0.4° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. Each angle here was measured at every hour of the civil day and held; whatever the missing clock said, this geometry was in it.

blocks.title: What the angles build
blocks.text: Venus opposes Neptune while both square Mars. A t-square aims the whole axis at its apex planet; the tradition reads it as the chart’s standing assignment.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Of the seven planets the classical scheme judges, three sit in a sign it has an opinion about. Mercury in Sagittarius at 16.2° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Mars in Libra at 2.9° is in detriment; Saturn in Aquarius at 15.5° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules. None of these labels is a verdict on a person; they describe how a function is situated, nothing more.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Of the 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: 4 in fire, 3 in air, 1 in earth, 1 in water by element, 4 mutable, 4 cardinal, 1 fixed by modality. A fire emphasis is read as appetite for the first move, with information gathered by doing rather than before doing. Jupiter, Neptune and Pluto were retrograde — motion that reverses only from this vantage point, and which the old reading treats as delay used for revision.

blocks.title: The Moon is genuinely open
blocks.text: The Moon crossed from Gemini into Cancer during that day at the birthplace, travelling 13.3° between one midnight and the next. The hour would decide it; no hour was recorded. The reading keeps the question open rather than flipping a coin dressed as astrology.
